recentItems.title: Jury convicts Duane Davis in orchestrating killing of Tupac Shakur
recentItems.description:
A jury has found Duane Davis guilty of orchestrating the 1996 drive-by shooting that killed rapper Tupac Shakur. 

The 63-year-old was convicted of murder with the use of a deadly weapon and could be sentenced to life in prison.

Jurors reached the verdict after less than three hours of deliberation, the court announced.
